decisions.focus: A quadratic-scaling algorithm with guaranteed convergence for quantum coupled-channel calculations

The paper presents a groundbreaking algorithm that addresses the computational bottleneck of quantum coupled-channel (CC) calculations by achieving quadratic scaling in computational cost. The WISE algorithm overcomes the limitations of traditional iterative methods through spectral regularization, ensuring convergence and stability even in the presence of closed channels and divergent eigenvalues. This method enables rigorous quantum scattering computations for complex molecular systems, significantly advancing the field of quantum dynamics in atomic, molecular, and astrochemistry.

evidence.text: Quantum collision dynamics of atoms, molecules, and nuclei is central to a vast array of fields ranging from atomic, molecular, and optical (AMO) physics ( 1 – 3 ) to chemical reaction dynamics ( 4 – 7 ), astrochemistry ( 8 , 9 ), and nuclear physics ( 10 ). Precision calculations of scattering observables—such as state-to-state cross sections and reaction rates—provide essential quantitative insights into complex quantum phenomena abundant in these fields. Examples include intricate mechanisms

In the following, we describe how the WISE framework overcomes the two primary challenges of the naive iterative approach ( 35 , 36 ): the rigorous inclusion of closed channels and the guaranteed convergence of the iterative series through spectral regularization.

This framework guarantees convergence regardless of the interaction strength or the presence of closed channels while retaining the favorable matrix-vector operational scaling. As shown in the right in Fig. 1B , the regularization procedure tames the exponential divergence of the Born series for the three-channel model of He + CO collisions with one closed channel, bringing the results in perfect agreement with exact CC calculations.

This setup creates a scattering problem of substantially greater complexity than He + CO collisions: The number of channels increases by an order of magnitude. Given the standard cubic scaling, this corresponds to a 1000-fold increase in computational cost. Figure 4B shows that our WISE algorithm successfully replicates exact CC results for the de-excitation cross section across a broad range of collision energies (1 to 1000 cm −1 ). The agreement is excellent over the entire energy range.

The resulting Weinberg-regularized Iterative Series Expansion (WISE) algorithm guarantees numerical convergence of scattering observables regardless of the strength or anisotropy of the interaction potential. We demonstrate the robustness and quadratic scaling of the WISE algorithm by applying it to multichannel He + CO and CO + N 2 collisions on ab initio potential energy surfaces (PESs). These results enable rigorous quantum scattering calculations on a wide array of molecular systems previous

classification_audit.abstract: Rigorous quantum dynamics calculations provide essential insights into complex scattering phenomena across atomic and molecular physics, chemical reaction dynamics, and astrochemistry. However, the application of the gold-standard quantum coupled-channel (CC) method has been fundamentally constrained by a steep cubic scaling of computational cost [ O ( N 3 ) ] . Here, we develop a general, rigorous, and robust method for solving the time-independent Schrödinger equation for a single column of the scattering S-matrix with quadratic scaling [ O ( N 2 ) ] in the number of channels. The Weinberg-regularized Iterative Series Expansion (WISE) algorithm resolves the divergence issues affecting iterative techniques by applying a regularization procedure to the kernel of the multichannel Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation. The method also explicitly incorporates closed-channel effects, including those responsible for multichannel Feshbach resonances. We demonstrate the power of this approach by performing rigorous calculations on He + CO and CO + N 2 collisions, achieving exact quantum results with quadratic scaling guaranteed by a contour-integral construction. Our results establish a highly scalable computational paradigm, enabling state-to-state quantum scattering computations for complex molecular systems.

items.action:
量子耦合通道（CC）计算是原子、分子、化学和核物理中解析复杂散射现象的重要工具。然而，传统的金标准CC方法因计算成本的立方级增长[O(N³)]而受到限制。本文提出了一种通用、严谨且稳健的方法，用于求解单列散射S矩阵的时间独立薛定谔方程，具有二次标度性[O(N²)]。Weinberg正则化的迭代级数展开（WISE）算法通过在多通道Lippmann-Schwinger积分方程的核中应用正则化程序，解决了迭代技术中的发散问题。该方法还明确纳入了闭合通道效应，包括导致多通道Feshbach共振的效应。我们通过在He + CO和CO + N₂碰撞上进行严谨计算，展示了这种方法的威力，实现了具有二次标度性的精确量子结果。我们的结果建立了一种高度可扩展的计算范式，使复杂分子系统的状态到状态量子散射计算成为可能，并为超冷分子物理、化学反应动力学和天体化学中的大规模数值模拟铺平了道路。

该方法的关键设计在于通过谱正则化确保迭代级数的收敛性。在理论部分，我们描述了WISE框架如何克服传统迭代方法的两个主要挑战：闭合通道的严格包含和迭代级数的保证收敛性。通过谱正则化处理，闭合通道的发散问题得到了有效控制，并且该方法保留了有利的矩阵-向量操作标度性。在应用部分，我们展示了WISE框架在量子分子碰撞动力学、冷和超冷化学以及天体化学中的广泛适用性。例如，在CO分子与He原子的冷碰撞中，该算法成功地复制了精确的CC结果。

该方法的实现分为三个阶段：首先构造参考格林函数；其次确定正则和不规则解；最后通过矩阵-向量操作计算离散核算子K。关键在于该算法不需要显式构建或存储完整的矩阵G、U off 或 K，而是实时计算这些操作。此外，通过矩阵自由的轮廓积分方法，该算法在大规模情况下仍能保持O(N²)的标度性，并且与闭合通道的数量无关。

综上所述，本文提出的方法为量子耦合通道计算提供了一种高效、稳健的解决方案，具有广泛的应用前景和理论价值。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说通过解决量子耦合通道计算中的收敛性和闭合通道问题，逐步验证并排除替代解释。首先，通过理论分析时间独立的Schrödinger方程，确定需要处理的多通道问题，并指出传统方法在封闭通道和收敛性上的局限性（p6, p16）。随后，提出Weinberg正则化迭代级数展开（WISE）算法，通过谱正则化解决闭合通道的发散问题并保证收敛性（p25, p26）。该方法通过分析LS核的谱半径和Weinberg特征值，确保迭代级数的稳定性（p34, p35）。在应用层面，通过He+CO和CO+N₂碰撞计算验证算法的有效性，并展示其对复杂分子系统的适用性（p47, p48）。综述分析则通过比较不同方法的收敛性和计算复杂度，强调WISE算法在处理大规模系统时的优势。每一步均基于理论推导和实验验证，确保结果的可靠性与可扩展性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过引入谱正则化方法，成功解决了多通道量子散射计算中闭合通道导致的发散问题，并实现了二次方标度的高效算法。这一机制可迁移至其他需要处理复杂多通道相互作用的问题，如化学反应动力学、天体化学等，但需确保交互势的perturbativeness在单位圆内。该方法通过矩阵-向量操作避免存储全矩阵，适用于大规模分子系统计算。
items.selection_reason: 该算法通过引入谱正则化技术，有效解决了量子耦合通道计算中闭合通道的收敛性问题，并实现了二次方标度。与传统方法相比，该方法在处理复杂分子系统时具有更高的可扩展性和稳定性。通过将多通道Lippmann-Schwinger积分方程的核分解为正则部分和发散部分，算法能够保证迭代级数的收敛性，同时避免了闭合通道对计算结果的影响。这种方法不仅提高了计算效率，还确保了在不同能量范围内的精确量子结果。实验表明，该方法在He+CO和CO+N2碰撞中实现了与精确耦合通道计算一致的结果，证明了其在复杂分子系统中的应用价值。
items.application_prospects: 本文提出了一种具有二次标度的量子耦合通道计算算法，能够有效解决复杂分子碰撞中的闭合通道问题。该方法通过谱正则化技术克服了传统迭代方法在收敛性和稳定性上的局限性，实现了对多通道系统的高效计算。其应用前景广泛，可应用于冷原子、分子物理、天体化学等领域的量子散射计算，尤其在处理大规模复杂系统时具有显著优势。实现条件要求具备高精度的势能面数据和稳定的数值方法，而约束主要来自计算资源和闭合通道的复杂性。
items.future_directions: 本文提出了一种基于谱正则化的二次标度算法，能够有效解决量子多通道计算中的闭合通道问题和迭代发散问题。未来可进一步研究该方法在更复杂分子系统中的应用，并探索其在超冷化学、天体化学等领域的扩展性。此外，需验证该算法在不同势能面下的鲁棒性和计算效率。

fields.en:
Quantum coupled channel (CC) calculations are important tools for parsing complex scattering phenomena in atomic, molecular, chemical, and nuclear physics. However, traditional gold standard CC methods are limited by the cubic cost of computation [O(N³)]. This paper proposes a general, rigorous, and robust method for solving the time-independent Schrödinger equation for single-channel scattering S matrix, with quadratic scaling [O(N²)]. The WISE algorithm, which is an iterative series expansion based on Weinberg regularization, addresses divergence issues in iterative techniques by applying regularization procedures to the kernel of the multi-channel Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation. The method also explicitly incorporates closure channel effects, including those leading to multi-channel Feshbach resonances. We demonstrate the power of this approach through rigorous calculations on He + CO and CO + N₂ collisions, achieving precise quantum results with quadratic scaling. Our results establish a highly scalable computational paradigm, making state-to-state quantum scattering calculations for complex molecular systems possible, and paving the way for large-scale numerical simulations in ultracold molecular physics, chemical reaction dynamics, and astrochemistry.

The key design of this method lies in ensuring the convergence of the iterative series through spectral regularization. In the theoretical part, we describe how the WISE framework overcomes two major challenges of traditional iterative methods: the strict inclusion of closed channels and the guaranteed convergence of the iterative series. By means of spectral regularization, the divergence problem of closed channels is effectively controlled, and the method retains the favorable scalability of matrix-vector operations. In the application part, we demonstrate the wide applicability of the WISE framework in quantum molecular collision dynamics, cold and ultra-cold chemistry, and astrochemistry. For example, in the cold collision of CO molecules with He atoms, the algorithm successfully replicates the accurate CC results.

The implementation of this method is divided into three stages: first, constructing the reference Green's function; second, determining regular and irregular solutions; and finally, computing the discrete kernel K through matrix-vector operations. The key lies in the fact that this algorithm does not require explicitly building or storing the complete matrices G, U off, or K, but rather computes these operations in real time. Additionally, through a matrix-free contour integral method, the algorithm maintains an O(N²) scalability for large-scale cases and is independent of the number of closed channels.

In summary, the method proposed in this paper provides an efficient and robust solution for quantum coupled-channel calculations, with broad application prospects and theoretical significance.

量子耦合通道（CC）计算是原子、分子、化学和核物理中解析复杂散射现象的重要工具。然而，传统的金标准CC方法因计算成本的立方级增长[O(N³)]而受到限制。本文提出了一种通用、严谨且稳健的方法，用于求解单列散射S矩阵的时间独立薛定谔方程，具有二次标度性[O(N²)]。Weinberg正则化的迭代级数展开（WISE）算法通过在多通道Lippmann-Schwinger积分方程的核中应用正则化程序，解决了迭代技术中的发散问题。该方法还明确纳入了闭合通道效应，包括导致多通道Feshbach共振的效应。我们通过在He + CO和CO + N₂碰撞上进行严谨计算，展示了这种方法的威力，实现了具有二次标度性的精确量子结果。我们的结果建立了一种高度可扩展的计算范式，使复杂分子系统的状态到状态量子散射计算成为可能，并为超冷分子物理、化学反应动力学和天体化学中的大规模数值模拟铺平了道路。

该方法的关键设计在于通过谱正则化确保迭代级数的收敛性。在理论部分，我们描述了WISE框架如何克服传统迭代方法的两个主要挑战：闭合通道的严格包含和迭代级数的保证收敛性。通过谱正则化处理，闭合通道的发散问题得到了有效控制，并且该方法保留了有利的矩阵-向量操作标度性。在应用部分，我们展示了WISE框架在量子分子碰撞动力学、冷和超冷化学以及天体化学中的广泛适用性。例如，在CO分子与He原子的冷碰撞中，该算法成功地复制了精确的CC结果。

该方法的实现分为三个阶段：首先构造参考格林函数；其次确定正则和不规则解；最后通过矩阵-向量操作计算离散核算子K。关键在于该算法不需要显式构建或存储完整的矩阵G、U off 或 K，而是实时计算这些操作。此外，通过矩阵自由的轮廓积分方法，该算法在大规模情况下仍能保持O(N²)的标度性，并且与闭合通道的数量无关。

综上所述，本文提出的方法为量子耦合通道计算提供了一种高效、稳健的解决方案，具有广泛的应用前景和理论价值。

paragraphs.en: Quantum coupled channel (CC) calculations are important tools for parsing complex scattering phenomena in atomic, molecular, chemical, and nuclear physics. However, traditional gold standard CC methods are limited by the cubic cost of computation [O(N³)]. This paper proposes a general, rigorous, and robust method for solving the time-independent Schrödinger equation for single-channel scattering S matrix, with quadratic scaling [O(N²)]. The WISE algorithm, which is an iterative series expansion based on Weinberg regularization, addresses divergence issues in iterative techniques by applying regularization procedures to the kernel of the multi-channel Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation. The method also explicitly incorporates closure channel effects, including those leading to multi-channel Feshbach resonances. We demonstrate the power of this approach through rigorous calculations on He + CO and CO + N₂ collisions, achieving precise quantum results with quadratic scaling. Our results establish a highly scalable computational paradigm, making state-to-state quantum scattering calculations for complex molecular systems possible, and paving the way for large-scale numerical simulations in ultracold molecular physics, chemical reaction dynamics, and astrochemistry.

paragraphs.en: The key design of this method lies in ensuring the convergence of the iterative series through spectral regularization. In the theoretical part, we describe how the WISE framework overcomes two major challenges of traditional iterative methods: the strict inclusion of closed channels and the guaranteed convergence of the iterative series. By means of spectral regularization, the divergence problem of closed channels is effectively controlled, and the method retains the favorable scalability of matrix-vector operations. In the application part, we demonstrate the wide applicability of the WISE framework in quantum molecular collision dynamics, cold and ultra-cold chemistry, and astrochemistry. For example, in the cold collision of CO molecules with He atoms, the algorithm successfully replicates the accurate CC results.

paragraphs.en: The implementation of this method is divided into three stages: first, constructing the reference Green's function; second, determining regular and irregular solutions; and finally, computing the discrete kernel K through matrix-vector operations. The key lies in the fact that this algorithm does not require explicitly building or storing the complete matrices G, U off, or K, but rather computes these operations in real time. Additionally, through a matrix-free contour integral method, the algorithm maintains an O(N²) scalability for large-scale cases and is independent of the number of closed channels.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法的实现分为三个阶段：首先构造参考格林函数；其次确定正则和不规则解；最后通过矩阵-向量操作计算离散核算子K。关键在于该算法不需要显式构建或存储完整的矩阵G、U off 或 K，而是实时计算这些操作。此外，通过矩阵自由的轮廓积分方法，该算法在大规模情况下仍能保持O(N²)的标度性，并且与闭合通道的数量无关。

paragraphs.en: In summary, the method proposed in this paper provides an efficient and robust solution for quantum coupled-channel calculations, with broad application prospects and theoretical significance.

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis that addresses the convergence and closure issues in quantum coupling channels to gradually verify and exclude alternative explanations. First, by theoretical analysis of the time-independent Schrödinger equation, the multi-channel problem to be addressed is determined, and the limitations of traditional methods in closed channels and convergence are pointed out (p6, p16). Subsequently, the Weinberg regularized iterative series expansion (WISE) algorithm is proposed, which solves the divergence problem in closed channels and ensures convergence through spectral regularization (p25, p26). This method ensures the stability of the iterative series by analyzing the spectral radius of the LS kernel and the Weinberg eigenvalues (p34, p35). In terms of application, the effectiveness of the algorithm is validated through collision calculations of He+CO and CO+N₂, demonstrating its applicability to complex molecular systems (p47, p48). The review analysis compares the convergence and computational complexity of different methods, emphasizing the advantages of the WISE algorithm in handling large-scale systems. Each step is based on theoretical derivation and experimental verification, ensuring the reliability and scalability of the results.
fields.zh: 作者提出假说通过解决量子耦合通道计算中的收敛性和闭合通道问题，逐步验证并排除替代解释。首先，通过理论分析时间独立的Schrödinger方程，确定需要处理的多通道问题，并指出传统方法在封闭通道和收敛性上的局限性（p6, p16）。随后，提出Weinberg正则化迭代级数展开（WISE）算法，通过谱正则化解决闭合通道的发散问题并保证收敛性（p25, p26）。该方法通过分析LS核的谱半径和Weinberg特征值，确保迭代级数的稳定性（p34, p35）。在应用层面，通过He+CO和CO+N₂碰撞计算验证算法的有效性，并展示其对复杂分子系统的适用性（p47, p48）。综述分析则通过比较不同方法的收敛性和计算复杂度，强调WISE算法在处理大规模系统时的优势。每一步均基于理论推导和实验验证，确保结果的可靠性与可扩展性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study successfully addressed the divergence problem caused by closed channels in multi-channel quantum scattering calculations by introducing a spectral regularization method, and achieved an efficient algorithm with quadratic scaling. This mechanism can be transferred to other problems requiring the treatment of complex multi-channel interactions, such as chemical reaction dynamics and astrochemistry, but it is necessary to ensure that the interaction potential is perturbative within the unit circle. The method avoids storing the full matrix by using matrix-vector operations, making it suitable for calculations involving large-scale molecular systems.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，该研究通过引入谱正则化方法，成功解决了多通道量子散射计算中闭合通道导致的发散问题，并实现了二次方标度的高效算法。这一机制可迁移至其他需要处理复杂多通道相互作用的问题，如化学反应动力学、天体化学等，但需确保交互势的perturbativeness在单位圆内。该方法通过矩阵-向量操作避免存储全矩阵，适用于大规模分子系统计算。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: The algorithm effectively addresses the convergence issue of closed channels in quantum coupled channel calculations by introducing spectral regularization, achieving quadratic scaling. Compared to traditional methods, this approach exhibits higher scalability and stability when handling complex molecular systems. By decomposing the kernel of the multi-channel Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation into regular and divergent parts, the algorithm ensures the convergence of iterative series while avoiding the influence of closed channels on computational results. This method not only improves computational efficiency but also ensures precise quantum results across different energy ranges. Experimental results show that this method achieves consistent results with exact coupled channel calculations in He+CO and CO+N2 collisions, demonstrating its application value in complex molecular systems.
fields.zh: 该算法通过引入谱正则化技术，有效解决了量子耦合通道计算中闭合通道的收敛性问题，并实现了二次方标度。与传统方法相比，该方法在处理复杂分子系统时具有更高的可扩展性和稳定性。通过将多通道Lippmann-Schwinger积分方程的核分解为正则部分和发散部分，算法能够保证迭代级数的收敛性，同时避免了闭合通道对计算结果的影响。这种方法不仅提高了计算效率，还确保了在不同能量范围内的精确量子结果。实验表明，该方法在He+CO和CO+N2碰撞中实现了与精确耦合通道计算一致的结果，证明了其在复杂分子系统中的应用价值。

fields.en: This paper proposes a quantum coupled channel calculation algorithm with quadratic scaling, which can effectively solve the closed channel problem in complex molecular collisions. The method overcomes the limitations of traditional iterative methods in convergence and stability through spectral regularization technology, achieving efficient computation for multi-channel systems. Its application prospects are broad, applicable to quantum scattering calculations in fields such as cold atom, molecular physics, and astrochemistry, particularly showing significant advantages in handling large-scale complex systems. The implementation requirements include high-precision potential energy surface data and stable numerical methods, while constraints mainly come from computational resources and the complexity of closed channels.

paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种基于谱正则化的二次标度算法，能够有效解决量子多通道计算中的闭合通道问题和迭代发散问题。未来可进一步研究该方法在更复杂分子系统中的应用，并探索其在超冷化学、天体化学等领域的扩展性。此外，需验证该算法在不同势能面下的鲁棒性和计算效率。

This review provides a comprehensive overview of enantioselective and enantiospecific transition-metal-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions, focusing on the development and challenges in achieving stereospecificity in C–C bond formation. The review highlights key advancements in catalyst design, ligand selection, and reaction mechanisms that enable enantioselectivity in alkyl cross-coupling reactions using organometallic reagents. It discusses both historical developments and recent innovations, emphasizing the role of chiral ligands and transition metals in achieving high enantioinduction. The review also critically evaluates the limitations and future directions in this field.

items.action: 在有机合成中，构建具有手性的C–C键仍然是一个重大挑战。过渡金属催化为化学家提供了新的工具来形成C–C键，并改变了合成策略。本综述涵盖了手性过渡金属催化的交叉偶联反应，包括有机亲电试剂和有机金属试剂的对映选择性和对映特异性反应。讨论了形成具有中心、轴向和平面手性的C–C键的反应，以及由底物中的立体中心控制形成的第二个手性中心的差向选择性反应。同时，仅限于含有单一立体中心的立体特异性反应，并排除了孤立烯烃、α,β-不饱和羰基化合物或孤立炔烃的偶联反应，包括不对称Heck反应、共轭加成反应和氧化环开反应。此外，计量级过渡金属介导的反应也不在讨论范围内。虽然使用烯醇ates和其他软亲核试剂的烯丙基取代反应超出了本综述的范围，但使用有机金属试剂的过渡金属催化的烯丙基取代反应将被讨论。Cu催化的不对称烯丙基取代反应在2008年前已被广泛评论，因此不在此处包含。尽管有初步报告，高度对映选择性的过渡金属催化的烷基交叉偶联反应的发展缓慢，部分原因是Pd催化烷基交叉偶联反应中普遍遇到的挑战。对于通过极性、双电子机制反应的Pd和其他金属来说，次甲基金属试剂通常比其n-烷基或C(sp²)杂化物更慢进行转金属化。同样，次甲基亲电试剂经常缓慢地与Pd发生氧化加成。此外，在任何情况下，生成的次甲基过渡金属复合物都可能经历快速、非产率的β-氢消除。因此，对映选择性的过渡金属催化的烷基交叉偶联反应的成功实现源于对控制和影响这些基本步骤因素（特别是配体）的根本研究。此外，对Ni催化剂的新兴趣，它们可以通过单电子氧化加成机制与次甲基卤化物相互作用，导致对映选择性烷基交叉偶联反应迅速增加。对映选择性的次甲基金属试剂的反应可以来自催化剂控制的动能分辨率过程，在这种情况下，两种对映体的chiral有机金属试剂的转金属化相对速率显著不同。此外，第三种可能性涉及立体破坏机制，其中起始材料的初始构型被破坏并由手性催化剂重置。在1972年，Corriu和Kumada独立报告了Ni催化的烷基镁卤化物与芳基或乙烯基卤化物的交叉偶联反应；不久之后，首次利用手性过渡金属复合物催化这些反应的对映选择性研究被报道。1973年和1974年，Consiglio和Kumada独立报告了由镍盐和手性双齿膦配体DIOP（L1）生成的复杂催化次丁基镁溴化物或氯化物与溴苯或氯苯反应生成产物1，具有良好的对映诱导（图3）。这些结果是手性交叉偶联领域的关键概念证明；然而，由于产率低，仍不清楚这些反应是通过次甲基镁试剂的动能分辨率还是通过DYKAT进行。随后报告称Prophos（L2）提供了更好的对映诱导和更高的1产率。有机卤化物和有机金属试剂上的卤素身份显著影响了1的绝对构型和对映过量（ee）。当使用Norphos（L4）作为手性配体时，观察到进一步的改进，生成1在50% ee。此外，一种来自糖类的手性配体（L3）也被报道可以生成1在良好的ee，尽管产率低。
items.research_logic: 作者通过系统分析不同过渡金属催化的交叉偶联反应，提出并验证了手性选择性的假说。在p6中，作者明确排除了不对称 Heck 反应、共轭加成反应等非目标反应，并聚焦于手性催化剂对立体化学的影响。p7指出，由于sec-烷基金属试剂的不稳定性，传统钯催化的交叉偶联反应难以实现高对映选择性，因此需要深入研究影响效率的因素，如配体的作用。p8和p9详细描述了通过动态动力学不对称转化（DYKAT）或催化剂控制的立体化学分辨率机制来实现手性选择性的可能途径。p10至p174展示了不同手性试剂（如有机镁、有机锌、有机硼）在不同过渡金属催化下的反应结果，验证了配体对立体选择性的关键作用，并通过实验排除了其他可能的机理。综述中通过对比不同配体和反应条件，系统分析了各反应路径的优劣，最终确认了DYKAT机制在手性交叉偶联中的有效性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，enantioselective transition-metal-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions的实验设计需基于催化剂的立体控制能力与反应物的构型稳定性。通过动态 kinetic asymmetric transformation（DYKAT）机制，可实现对产物立体化学的高效控制，适用于类似轴向手性构建的反应。该原则适用于其他需要立体选择性的交叉偶联反应，但受限于催化剂的立体导向性和反应物的构型稳定性。
items.selection_reason: 该综述系统梳理了过渡金属催化不对称交叉偶联反应的发展历程与机制，重点分析了二级烷基金属试剂在构建手性C–C键中的作用。通过对比不同金属催化剂（如Ni、Pd）及配体对反应效率和立体选择性的调控，揭示了动态动力学不对称转化（DYKAT）等关键机制。文献中提到的多个案例表明，利用手性配体控制氧化加成产物的快速平衡，可实现高对映体过量（ee）的偶联产物。例如，使用PHOX、Norphos等配体时，可获得50%以上的ee值；而通过改进反应条件和配体设计，进一步提升了选择性和产率。综述强调了实验与理论结合的重要性，指出不同金属催化剂对二级烷基试剂的反应活性差异显著，且立体选择性受配体空间效应和电子效应共同影响。这些研究为不对称交叉偶联反应提供了系统性的理论支持和实践指导，超越了传统流水线工作模式，体现了科学探索的深度与广度。
items.application_prospects: 本文综述了过渡金属催化的手性交叉偶联反应在构建C–C键中的应用前景。该技术通过控制配体和反应条件，实现了对产物立体化学的精确调控。尽管存在如β-氢消除等挑战，但Ni催化剂和特定配体的应用显著提高了反应效率与选择性。例如，使用chiral phosphine ligands可实现高ee值的产物合成，且在环境友好条件下具有应用潜力。然而，该技术仍受限于反应条件控制及立体化学稳定性，需进一步优化以提高产率和选择性。
items.future_directions: 未来可检验的问题包括：如何优化Ni催化剂在sec-alkyl halides中的单电子氧化加成机制以提高enantioselective alkyl cross-coupling的效率？此外，探索不同chiral ligands对DYKAT过程的影响，以及开发更高效的立体选择性反应条件，可能为过渡金属催化的不对称交叉偶联提供新的方向。

fields.en: In organic synthesis, the construction of chiral C–C bonds remains a major challenge. Transition metal catalysis has provided chemists with new tools for forming C–C bonds and has changed synthetic strategies. This review covers enantioselective and enantiotopic reactions of chiral transition metal-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions, including organo electrophilic reagents and organometallic reagents. The discussion includes reactions that form C–C bonds with central, axial, and planar chirality, as well as difference-selective reactions for forming a second chiral center controlled by the stereocenter in the substrate. At the same time, only reactions with a single stereocenter are considered, and coupling reactions involving isolated alkenes, α,β-unsaturated carbonyl compounds, or isolated alkynes are excluded, including asymmetric Heck reactions, conjugate addition reactions, and oxidative cleavage reactions. Furthermore, stoichiometric transition metal-mediated reactions are not within the scope of discussion. Although the allylic substitution reactions using enolates and other soft nucleophiles are beyond the scope of this review, the transition metal-catalyzed allylic substitution reactions using organometallic reagents will be discussed. The asymmetric allylic substitution reactions catalyzed by Cu have been widely reviewed before 2008, so they are not included here. Despite preliminary reports, the development of highly enantioselective transition metal-catalyzed alkyl cross-coupling reactions has progressed slowly, in part due to challenges commonly encountered in Pd-catalyzed alkyl cross-coupling reactions. For Pd and other metals reacting through polar, double-electron mechanisms, methyl metallometals are generally slower in transmetallation than their n-alkyl or C(sp²) hybrid counterparts. Similarly, methyl electrophilic reagents often react slowly with Pd in oxidative addition. Furthermore, in any case, the generated methyl transition metal complexes may undergo rapid, non-productive β-hydrogen elimination. Therefore, the successful implementation of enantioselective transition metal-catalyzed alkyl cross-coupling reactions depends on fundamental research into factors that control and influence these basic steps (particularly ligands). In addition, there is a new interest in Ni catalysts, which can interact with methylene halides through a single-electron oxidation addition mechanism, leading to a rapid increase in enantioselective alkyl cross-coupling reactions. The reaction of enantioselective methylenemetal reagents can originate from kinetic resolution processes controlled by the catalyst, in which the relative rates of metallation of chiral organic metal reagents for the two enantiomers are significantly different. Furthermore, a third possibility involves a stereobreaking mechanism, where the initial configuration of the starting material is destroyed and reset by the chiral catalyst. In 1972, Corriu and Kumada independently reported the cross-coupling reaction between alkylmagnesium halides and aryl or vinyl halides catalyzed by Ni; shortly thereafter, the first studies on enantioselective catalysis of these reactions using chiral transition metal complexes were reported. In 1973 and 1974, Consiglio and Kumada independently reported the formation of product 1 from complex catalytic cross-coupling of isobutylmagnesium bromide or chloride with bromobenzene or chlorobenzene, generated by nickel salts and chiral bidentate phosphine ligands DIOP (L1), exhibiting good enantioinduction (Figure 3). These results are key conceptual proofs in the field of chiral cross-coupling; however, due to low yields, it is still unclear whether these reactions proceed through kinetic resolution of methylenemagnesium reagents or through DYKAT. Subsequent reports indicated that Prophos (L2) provides better enantioinduction and higher yield for product 1. The identity of the halogen on organic halides and organic metal reagents significantly affects the absolute configuration and enantiomeric excess (ee) of product 1. When using Norphos (L4) as a chiral ligand, further improvements were observed, generating product 1 with 50% ee. Additionally, a chiral ligand derived from carbohydrates (L3) was also reported to generate product 1 with good ee, although the yield is low.

paragraphs.en: In organic synthesis, the construction of chiral C–C bonds remains a major challenge. Transition metal catalysis has provided chemists with new tools for forming C–C bonds and has changed synthetic strategies. This review covers enantioselective and enantiotopic reactions of chiral transition metal-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions, including organo electrophilic reagents and organometallic reagents. The discussion includes reactions that form C–C bonds with central, axial, and planar chirality, as well as difference-selective reactions for forming a second chiral center controlled by the stereocenter in the substrate. At the same time, only reactions with a single stereocenter are considered, and coupling reactions involving isolated alkenes, α,β-unsaturated carbonyl compounds, or isolated alkynes are excluded, including asymmetric Heck reactions, conjugate addition reactions, and oxidative cleavage reactions. Furthermore, stoichiometric transition metal-mediated reactions are not within the scope of discussion. Although the allylic substitution reactions using enolates and other soft nucleophiles are beyond the scope of this review, the transition metal-catalyzed allylic substitution reactions using organometallic reagents will be discussed. The asymmetric allylic substitution reactions catalyzed by Cu have been widely reviewed before 2008, so they are not included here. Despite preliminary reports, the development of highly enantioselective transition metal-catalyzed alkyl cross-coupling reactions has progressed slowly, in part due to challenges commonly encountered in Pd-catalyzed alkyl cross-coupling reactions. For Pd and other metals reacting through polar, double-electron mechanisms, methyl metallometals are generally slower in transmetallation than their n-alkyl or C(sp²) hybrid counterparts. Similarly, methyl electrophilic reagents often react slowly with Pd in oxidative addition. Furthermore, in any case, the generated methyl transition metal complexes may undergo rapid, non-productive β-hydrogen elimination. Therefore, the successful implementation of enantioselective transition metal-catalyzed alkyl cross-coupling reactions depends on fundamental research into factors that control and influence these basic steps (particularly ligands). In addition, there is a new interest in Ni catalysts, which can interact with methylene halides through a single-electron oxidation addition mechanism, leading to a rapid increase in enantioselective alkyl cross-coupling reactions. The reaction of enantioselective methylenemetal reagents can originate from kinetic resolution processes controlled by the catalyst, in which the relative rates of metallation of chiral organic metal reagents for the two enantiomers are significantly different. Furthermore, a third possibility involves a stereobreaking mechanism, where the initial configuration of the starting material is destroyed and reset by the chiral catalyst. In 1972, Corriu and Kumada independently reported the cross-coupling reaction between alkylmagnesium halides and aryl or vinyl halides catalyzed by Ni; shortly thereafter, the first studies on enantioselective catalysis of these reactions using chiral transition metal complexes were reported. In 1973 and 1974, Consiglio and Kumada independently reported the formation of product 1 from complex catalytic cross-coupling of isobutylmagnesium bromide or chloride with bromobenzene or chlorobenzene, generated by nickel salts and chiral bidentate phosphine ligands DIOP (L1), exhibiting good enantioinduction (Figure 3). These results are key conceptual proofs in the field of chiral cross-coupling; however, due to low yields, it is still unclear whether these reactions proceed through kinetic resolution of methylenemagnesium reagents or through DYKAT. Subsequent reports indicated that Prophos (L2) provides better enantioinduction and higher yield for product 1. The identity of the halogen on organic halides and organic metal reagents significantly affects the absolute configuration and enantiomeric excess (ee) of product 1. When using Norphos (L4) as a chiral ligand, further improvements were observed, generating product 1 with 50% ee. Additionally, a chiral ligand derived from carbohydrates (L3) was also reported to generate product 1 with good ee, although the yield is low.

fields.en: The author proposes and verifies the hypothesis of chiral selectivity through a systematic analysis of cross-coupling reactions catalyzed by different transition metals. In p6, the author explicitly excludes non-target reactions such as asymmetric Heck reactions and conjugate addition reactions, focusing instead on the effect of chiral catalysts on stereochemistry. p7 points out that due to the instability of sec-alkyl metal reagents, traditional palladium-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions are difficult to achieve high enantioselectivity, thus requiring further study of factors affecting efficiency, such as the role of ligands. p8 and p9 describe in detail the possible pathways for achieving chiral selectivity through dynamic kinetic asymmetry (DYKAT) or catalyst-controlled stereoselective resolution mechanisms. p10 to p174 demonstrate the reaction results of different chiral reagents (such as organomagnesium, organozinc, and organoboron) under different transition metal catalysis, verifying the critical role of ligands in stereoselectivity and excluding other possible mechanisms through experiments. The review systematically analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of various reaction pathways by comparing different ligands and reaction conditions, ultimately confirming the effectiveness of the DYKAT mechanism in chiral cross-coupling.
fields.zh: 作者通过系统分析不同过渡金属催化的交叉偶联反应，提出并验证了手性选择性的假说。在p6中，作者明确排除了不对称 Heck 反应、共轭加成反应等非目标反应，并聚焦于手性催化剂对立体化学的影响。p7指出，由于sec-烷基金属试剂的不稳定性，传统钯催化的交叉偶联反应难以实现高对映选择性，因此需要深入研究影响效率的因素，如配体的作用。p8和p9详细描述了通过动态动力学不对称转化（DYKAT）或催化剂控制的立体化学分辨率机制来实现手性选择性的可能途径。p10至p174展示了不同手性试剂（如有机镁、有机锌、有机硼）在不同过渡金属催化下的反应结果，验证了配体对立体选择性的关键作用，并通过实验排除了其他可能的机理。综述中通过对比不同配体和反应条件，系统分析了各反应路径的优劣，最终确认了DYKAT机制在手性交叉偶联中的有效性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that the experimental design of enantioselective transition-metal-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions should be based on the stereodirecting ability of the catalyst and the configurational stability of the reactants. Through the dynamic kinetic asymmetric transformation (DYKAT) mechanism, efficient control of the stereochemistry of the product can be achieved, making it suitable for reactions similar to axial chirality construction. This principle applies to other cross-coupling reactions requiring stereoselectivity, but is limited by the stereodirecting ability of the catalyst and the configurational stability of the reactants.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，enantioselective transition-metal-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions的实验设计需基于催化剂的立体控制能力与反应物的构型稳定性。通过动态 kinetic asymmetric transformation（DYKAT）机制，可实现对产物立体化学的高效控制，适用于类似轴向手性构建的反应。该原则适用于其他需要立体选择性的交叉偶联反应，但受限于催化剂的立体导向性和反应物的构型稳定性。

Through the dynamic kinetic asymmetric transformation (DYKAT) mechanism, efficient control of the stereochemistry of the product can be achieved, making it suitable for reactions similar to axial chirality construction. This principle applies to other cross-coupling reactions requiring stereoselectivity, but is limited by the stereodirecting ability of the catalyst and the configurational stability of the reactants.
paragraphs.zh: 我的归纳是，enantioselective transition-metal-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions的实验设计需基于催化剂的立体控制能力与反应物的构型稳定性。通过动态 kinetic asymmetric transformation（DYKAT）机制，可实现对产物立体化学的高效控制，适用于类似轴向手性构建的反应。该原则适用于其他需要立体选择性的交叉偶联反应，但受限于催化剂的立体导向性和反应物的构型稳定性。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This review systematically summarizes the development and mechanisms of asymmetric cross-coupling reactions catalyzed by transition metals, with a focus on the role of secondary arylmetal reagents in the construction of chiral C–C bonds. By comparing different metal catalysts (such as Ni, Pd) and ligands, the efficiency and stereoselectivity of the reaction are analyzed, revealing key mechanisms such as dynamic kinetic asymmetry (DYKAT). Several cases mentioned in the literature show that using chiral ligands to control the rapid equilibrium of oxidation addition products can achieve high enantiomeric excess (ee) in coupling products. For example, when using PHOX, Norphos, etc., an ee value of more than 50% can be achieved; further improvements in reaction conditions and ligand design have enhanced selectivity and yield. The review emphasizes the importance of combining experimental and theoretical studies, pointing out significant differences in the reactivity of secondary arylmetal reagents toward different metal catalysts, and that stereoselectivity is influenced by both spatial and electronic effects of the ligands. These studies provide systematic theoretical support and practical guidance for asymmetric cross-coupling reactions, surpassing traditional pipeline work models, demonstrating the depth and breadth of scientific exploration.
fields.zh: 该综述系统梳理了过渡金属催化不对称交叉偶联反应的发展历程与机制，重点分析了二级烷基金属试剂在构建手性C–C键中的作用。通过对比不同金属催化剂（如Ni、Pd）及配体对反应效率和立体选择性的调控，揭示了动态动力学不对称转化（DYKAT）等关键机制。文献中提到的多个案例表明，利用手性配体控制氧化加成产物的快速平衡，可实现高对映体过量（ee）的偶联产物。例如，使用PHOX、Norphos等配体时，可获得50%以上的ee值；而通过改进反应条件和配体设计，进一步提升了选择性和产率。综述强调了实验与理论结合的重要性，指出不同金属催化剂对二级烷基试剂的反应活性差异显著，且立体选择性受配体空间效应和电子效应共同影响。这些研究为不对称交叉偶联反应提供了系统性的理论支持和实践指导，超越了传统流水线工作模式，体现了科学探索的深度与广度。

fields.en: This paper reviews the prospects of chiral cross-coupling reactions catalyzed by transition metals in the construction of C–C bonds. This technology achieves precise control over the stereochemistry of the product by regulating ligands and reaction conditions. Although challenges such as β-hydrogen elimination exist, the application of Ni catalysts and specific ligands significantly improves reaction efficiency and selectivity. For example, the use of chiral phosphine ligands enables the synthesis of products with high ee values, and shows potential for application under environmentally friendly conditions. However, this technology is still limited by control over reaction conditions and stereochemical stability, requiring further optimization to improve yield and selectivity.
fields.zh: 本文综述了过渡金属催化的手性交叉偶联反应在构建C–C键中的应用前景。该技术通过控制配体和反应条件，实现了对产物立体化学的精确调控。尽管存在如β-氢消除等挑战，但Ni催化剂和特定配体的应用显著提高了反应效率与选择性。例如，使用chiral phosphine ligands可实现高ee值的产物合成，且在环境友好条件下具有应用潜力。然而，该技术仍受限于反应条件控制及立体化学稳定性，需进一步优化以提高产率和选择性。

fields.en: Future testable questions include: How to optimize the Ni catalyst for the single-electron oxidation addition mechanism in sec-alkyl halides to enhance the efficiency of enantioselective alkyl cross-coupling? Additionally, exploring the effects of different chiral ligands on the DYKAT process, as well as developing more efficient stereoselective reaction conditions, may provide new directions for asymmetric cross-coupling catalyzed by transition metals.
fields.zh: 未来可检验的问题包括：如何优化Ni催化剂在sec-alkyl halides中的单电子氧化加成机制以提高enantioselective alkyl cross-coupling的效率？此外，探索不同chiral ligands对DYKAT过程的影响，以及开发更高效的立体选择性反应条件，可能为过渡金属催化的不对称交叉偶联提供新的方向。

decisions.focus: Wearable/disposable sweat-based glucose monitoring device with multistage transdermal drug delivery module

The paper presents a novel wearable/disposable device for noninvasive glucose monitoring and transdermal drug delivery, integrating advanced sensor technology with controlled drug release. The system uses a stretchable, ultrathin design to enable continuous, painless monitoring of sweat-based glucose levels and precise drug delivery through microneedles. The integration of multiple sensors (humidity, glucose, pH, temperature) and the use of porous gold electrodes for enhanced sensitivity are key innovations that improve the reliability and accuracy of non-invasive diabetes management.

items.action:
糖尿病是一种最常见的慢性疾病，导致血糖水平无法控制。患者被建议每天检查血糖水平并定期注射胰岛素以持续管理血糖水平。然而，由于重复的血液采集和胰岛素注射带来的疼痛和压力，患者往往不遵循这一建议，这可能导致多种严重的糖尿病并发症，如心血管疾病、肾病、中风、失明和神经退行。此外，胰岛素过量治疗会导致血糖浓度急剧下降，可能引起癫痫发作、意识丧失甚至死亡。因此，一种无痛、无压力的葡萄糖监测方法以及通过受控药物输送维持稳态的精确方法是高度理想的。

本研究开发了一种基于汗水的葡萄糖监测设备和透皮给药模块，用于非侵入性糖尿病治疗。该系统具有多个优势：（i）兼容大规模生产的多孔金属电极和制造工艺；（ii）微型化传感器设计允许在极少量汗液的情况下进行可靠的汗液分析；（iii）贴片和一次性类型的设计提高了实际应用性；（iv）多种汗液控制和吸收层用于高效的汗液收集；（v）多孔金纳米结构最大化电化学活性表面积，以高灵敏度检测汗液中的微量葡萄糖；（vi）多个葡萄糖传感器提高准确性；（vii）通过生物相容性的透明质酸水凝胶微针进行多阶段和精确控制的透皮药物输送。Metformin是治疗2型糖尿病的一线药物。

该系统实现了高精度汗液葡萄糖测量和反馈控制的药物输送，使血糖浓度的有效管理成为可能，而无需疼痛和压力。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说，即开发一种非侵入式糖尿病监测设备，通过皮肤传输药物以实现精准的血糖管理。该假说基于现有方法的局限性，如频繁采血和胰岛素注射带来的疼痛和压力。为验证此假说，作者设计了一种可穿戴/一次性装置，结合多阶段透皮给药模块，用于非侵入式汗液葡萄糖监测与反馈控制药物输送。通过实验逐步验证该系统的有效性：首先，开发了基于超薄和可拉伸设计的传感器，实现微量汗液分析；其次，利用微针阵列进行精准药物输送，并通过多阶段热控实现药物按需释放。同时，作者排除了替代解释，如汗液中其他分子可能干扰葡萄糖检测，通过负电荷层筛选出干扰物质。综述部分则通过系统设计和实验数据比较，强调了多传感器协同工作的重要性，以及微针与热控结合的创新性。每一步均基于实际测试结果，确保系统的可靠性和实用性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过多阶段透皮给药模块设计了一种可穿戴/一次性 sweat-based 血糖监测设备，其核心在于利用微针实现精准药物输送。该系统通过多层结构优化汗水收集与分析，并结合电化学传感器提高检测灵敏度。实验表明，这种设计能够有效提升血糖监测的准确性与稳定性，同时减少患者痛苦和压力。该机制可迁移至其他非侵入式医疗监测领域，如持续血压或体温监控，但需注意其对皮肤湿度和温度变化的敏感性限制。
items.selection_reason: 该系统通过创新设计实现了无创血糖监测与精准药物输送，超越了传统流水线工作模式。其核心优势在于多阶段、可控的透皮给药模块和高灵敏度的葡萄糖检测机制。系统采用可拉伸的微针阵列，结合生物相容性材料（如透明质酸水凝胶）实现药物缓释，避免了消化道副作用。同时，多层结构设计有效收集汗液并提高检测精度，确保在极少量汗液条件下仍能稳定工作。该系统通过实时监测pH、温度和湿度，动态校正酶基葡萄糖传感器的偏差，显著提升测量准确性。其微型化设计与多点传感技术相结合，实现了高灵敏度、低耗量的血糖监测，为糖尿病管理提供了更高效的非侵入性解决方案。
items.application_prospects: 本文提出了一种基于汗水的葡萄糖监测设备与多阶段透皮给药模块，用于非侵入性糖尿病治疗。该系统通过可穿戴贴片和一次性条带实现无创葡萄糖监测及精准药物输送，具有高灵敏度、小样本量需求和多阶段控释特点。其应用前景在于提升糖尿病患者生活质量，实现持续血糖管理。实现条件包括柔性传感器设计、多层汗水控制结构及生物相容性给药系统。约束主要为设备成本与规模化生产难度，以及对环境温度的依赖性。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可聚焦于优化多阶段热控药物递送系统的精准度与稳定性，探索不同温度梯度对药物释放效率的影响。此外，进一步验证微针在多种皮肤类型上的适应性及生物相容性，以及开发更高效的 sweat-uptake 层以提升葡萄糖检测的灵敏度和可靠性。

fields.en:
Diabetes is a common chronic disease that leads to uncontrolled blood sugar levels. Patients are advised to check their blood sugar levels daily and to regularly inject insulin to maintain blood sugar control. However, due to the pain and stress caused by repeated blood draws and insulin injections, patients often do not follow this advice, which may lead to various severe diabetes complications, such as cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, stroke, blindness, and neurodegeneration. Additionally, excessive insulin treatment can cause a rapid drop in blood glucose levels, potentially leading to seizures, loss of consciousness, and even death. Therefore, an painless and stress-free method for monitoring glucose levels, as well as a precise method for maintaining homeostasis through controlled drug delivery, is highly desirable.

This study developed a glucose monitoring device and a transdermal drug delivery module based on sweat, for non-invasive diabetes treatment. The system has several advantages: (i) compatibility with large-scale production of porous metal electrodes and manufacturing processes; (ii) miniaturized sensor design allows reliable sweat analysis with minimal amounts of sweat; (iii) design of patches and single-use types improves practical applicability; (iv) multiple sweat control and absorption layers are used for efficient sweat collection; (v) porous gold nanostructures maximize the electrochemical active surface area, enabling high sensitivity detection of trace glucose in sweat; (vi) multiple glucose sensors improve accuracy; (vii) transdermal drug delivery through biocompatible hyaluronic acid hydrogel microneedles allows multi-stage and precise control. Metformin is the first-line drug for treating type 2 diabetes.

The system achieves high-precision glucose measurement in sweat and feedback control for drug delivery, making effective management of blood glucose concentration possible without pain and stress.
fields.zh:
糖尿病是一种最常见的慢性疾病，导致血糖水平无法控制。患者被建议每天检查血糖水平并定期注射胰岛素以持续管理血糖水平。然而，由于重复的血液采集和胰岛素注射带来的疼痛和压力，患者往往不遵循这一建议，这可能导致多种严重的糖尿病并发症，如心血管疾病、肾病、中风、失明和神经退行。此外，胰岛素过量治疗会导致血糖浓度急剧下降，可能引起癫痫发作、意识丧失甚至死亡。因此，一种无痛、无压力的葡萄糖监测方法以及通过受控药物输送维持稳态的精确方法是高度理想的。

本研究开发了一种基于汗水的葡萄糖监测设备和透皮给药模块，用于非侵入性糖尿病治疗。该系统具有多个优势：（i）兼容大规模生产的多孔金属电极和制造工艺；（ii）微型化传感器设计允许在极少量汗液的情况下进行可靠的汗液分析；（iii）贴片和一次性类型的设计提高了实际应用性；（iv）多种汗液控制和吸收层用于高效的汗液收集；（v）多孔金纳米结构最大化电化学活性表面积，以高灵敏度检测汗液中的微量葡萄糖；（vi）多个葡萄糖传感器提高准确性；（vii）通过生物相容性的透明质酸水凝胶微针进行多阶段和精确控制的透皮药物输送。Metformin是治疗2型糖尿病的一线药物。

该系统实现了高精度汗液葡萄糖测量和反馈控制的药物输送，使血糖浓度的有效管理成为可能，而无需疼痛和压力。

fields.en: The author proposed a hypothesis that developing a non-invasive diabetes monitoring device, which delivers drugs through the skin to achieve precise glucose management. This hypothesis is based on the limitations of existing methods, such as the pain and stress caused by frequent blood sampling and insulin injections. To validate this hypothesis, the author designed a wearable/one-time-use device combining a multi-stage transdermal drug delivery module for non-invasive sweat glucose monitoring and feedback-controlled drug delivery. The effectiveness of the system was experimentally verified step by step: first, a sensor based on ultra-thin and stretchable design was developed to achieve micro-sweat analysis; second, precise drug delivery was achieved using microneedle arrays, and multi-stage thermal control ensured drug release on demand. At the same time, the author excluded alternative explanations, such as other molecules in sweat potentially interfering with glucose detection, by screening out interferents through a negatively charged layer. The review section emphasized the importance of multi-sensor collaboration and the innovativeness of combining microneedles with thermal control through systematic design and experimental data comparison. Each step was based on actual test results to ensure the reliability and practicality of the system.
fields.zh: 作者提出假说，即开发一种非侵入式糖尿病监测设备，通过皮肤传输药物以实现精准的血糖管理。该假说基于现有方法的局限性，如频繁采血和胰岛素注射带来的疼痛和压力。为验证此假说，作者设计了一种可穿戴/一次性装置，结合多阶段透皮给药模块，用于非侵入式汗液葡萄糖监测与反馈控制药物输送。通过实验逐步验证该系统的有效性：首先，开发了基于超薄和可拉伸设计的传感器，实现微量汗液分析；其次，利用微针阵列进行精准药物输送，并通过多阶段热控实现药物按需释放。同时，作者排除了替代解释，如汗液中其他分子可能干扰葡萄糖检测，通过负电荷层筛选出干扰物质。综述部分则通过系统设计和实验数据比较，强调了多传感器协同工作的重要性，以及微针与热控结合的创新性。每一步均基于实际测试结果，确保系统的可靠性和实用性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study designed a wearable/one-time-use sweat-based glucose monitoring device through a multi-stage transdermal drug delivery module, with the core being the use of microneedles for precise drug delivery. The system optimizes sweat collection and analysis through a multi-layer structure and combines electrochemical sensors to enhance detection sensitivity. Experiments show that this design can effectively improve the accuracy and stability of glucose monitoring while reducing patient discomfort and stress. This mechanism can be adapted to other non-invasive medical monitoring fields, such as continuous blood pressure or temperature monitoring, but it should be noted that it is sensitive to changes in skin humidity and temperature.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，该研究通过多阶段透皮给药模块设计了一种可穿戴/一次性 sweat-based 血糖监测设备，其核心在于利用微针实现精准药物输送。该系统通过多层结构优化汗水收集与分析，并结合电化学传感器提高检测灵敏度。实验表明，这种设计能够有效提升血糖监测的准确性与稳定性，同时减少患者痛苦和压力。该机制可迁移至其他非侵入式医疗监测领域，如持续血压或体温监控，但需注意其对皮肤湿度和温度变化的敏感性限制。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: The system achieves non-invasive glucose monitoring and precise drug delivery through an innovative design, surpassing traditional line-based work models. Its core advantages lie in a multi-stage, controllable transdermal drug delivery module and a high-sensitivity glucose detection mechanism. The system uses stretchable microneedle arrays combined with biocompatible materials (such as hyaluronic acid hydrogels) to achieve drug sustained release, avoiding gastrointestinal side effects. At the same time, the multi-layer structure design effectively collects sweat and improves detection accuracy, ensuring stable operation even under minimal sweat conditions. The system dynamically corrects bias in enzyme-based glucose sensors through real-time monitoring of pH, temperature, and humidity, significantly enhancing measurement accuracy. Its miniaturized design combined with multi-point sensing technology realizes high sensitivity and low consumption for glucose monitoring, providing a more efficient non-invasive solution for diabetes management.
fields.zh: 该系统通过创新设计实现了无创血糖监测与精准药物输送，超越了传统流水线工作模式。其核心优势在于多阶段、可控的透皮给药模块和高灵敏度的葡萄糖检测机制。系统采用可拉伸的微针阵列，结合生物相容性材料（如透明质酸水凝胶）实现药物缓释，避免了消化道副作用。同时，多层结构设计有效收集汗液并提高检测精度，确保在极少量汗液条件下仍能稳定工作。该系统通过实时监测pH、温度和湿度，动态校正酶基葡萄糖传感器的偏差，显著提升测量准确性。其微型化设计与多点传感技术相结合，实现了高灵敏度、低耗量的血糖监测，为糖尿病管理提供了更高效的非侵入性解决方案。

paragraphs.en: The system achieves non-invasive glucose monitoring and precise drug delivery through an innovative design, surpassing traditional line-based work models. Its core advantages lie in a multi-stage, controllable transdermal drug delivery module and a high-sensitivity glucose detection mechanism. The system uses stretchable microneedle arrays combined with biocompatible materials (such as hyaluronic acid hydrogels) to achieve drug sustained release, avoiding gastrointestinal side effects. At the same time, the multi-layer structure design effectively collects sweat and improves detection accuracy, ensuring stable operation even under minimal sweat conditions. The system dynamically corrects bias in enzyme-based glucose sensors through real-time monitoring of pH, temperature, and humidity, significantly enhancing measurement accuracy. Its miniaturized design combined with multi-point sensing technology realizes high sensitivity and low consumption for glucose monitoring, providing a more efficient non-invasive solution for diabetes management.

fields.en: This paper proposes a glucose monitoring device based on sweat and a multi-stage transdermal drug delivery module for non-invasive diabetes treatment. The system enables non-invasive glucose monitoring and precise drug delivery through wearable patches and single-use strips, characterized by high sensitivity, low sample volume requirements, and multi-stage controlled release. Its application prospects lie in improving the quality of life for diabetic patients and achieving continuous glucose management. Realization conditions include flexible sensor design, multi-layer sweat control structures, and biocompatible drug delivery systems. Constraints mainly involve device cost and difficulties in large-scale production, as well as dependency on environmental temperature.
fields.zh: 本文提出了一种基于汗水的葡萄糖监测设备与多阶段透皮给药模块，用于非侵入性糖尿病治疗。该系统通过可穿戴贴片和一次性条带实现无创葡萄糖监测及精准药物输送，具有高灵敏度、小样本量需求和多阶段控释特点。其应用前景在于提升糖尿病患者生活质量，实现持续血糖管理。实现条件包括柔性传感器设计、多层汗水控制结构及生物相容性给药系统。约束主要为设备成本与规模化生产难度，以及对环境温度的依赖性。

fields.en: Future research can focus on optimizing the precision and stability of multi-stage thermal control drug delivery systems, exploring the impact of different temperature gradients on drug release efficiency. Additionally, further verification of microneedles' adaptability and biocompatibility across various skin types, as well as the development of more efficient sweat-uptake layers to enhance the sensitivity and reliability of glucose detection.
fields.zh: 未来研究可聚焦于优化多阶段热控药物递送系统的精准度与稳定性，探索不同温度梯度对药物释放效率的影响。此外，进一步验证微针在多种皮肤类型上的适应性及生物相容性，以及开发更高效的 sweat-uptake 层以提升葡萄糖检测的灵敏度和可靠性。

decisions.focus: 3D printing of conducting polymers for advanced electronic and biomedical applications

The article presents a significant advancement in the field of 3D printing of conducting polymers by developing a high-performance 3D printable ink based on PEDOT:PSS, which enables the fabrication of complex microstructures with high resolution and aspect ratio. The study demonstrates the versatility of this ink in multi-material 3D printing and its application in creating functional devices such as a soft neural probe for in vivo bioelectronic signal recording. The rheological properties of the ink are carefully optimized to ensure reliable 3D printing, and the resulting materials exhibit both high conductivity and mechanical flexibility. This work represents a novel approach to fabricating conducting polymers with potential applications in flexible electronics and bioelectronics.

classification_audit.abstract: Conducting polymers are promising material candidates in diverse applications including energy storage, flexible electronics, and bioelectronics. However, the fabrication of conducting polymers has mostly relied on conventional approaches such as ink-jet printing, screen printing, and electron-beam lithography, whose limitations have hampered rapid innovations and broad applications of conducting polymers. Here we introduce a high-performance 3D printable conducting polymer ink based on poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):polystyrene sulfonate (PEDOT:PSS) for 3D printing of conducting polymers. The resultant superior printability enables facile fabrication of conducting polymers into high resolution and high aspect ratio microstructures, which can be integrated with other materials such as insulating elastomers via multi-material 3D printing. The 3D-printed conducting polymers can also be converted into highly conductive and soft hydrogel microstructures. We further demonstrate fast and streamlined fabrications of various conducting polymer devices, such as a soft neural probe capable of in vivo single-unit recording.

items.action:
3D打印导电聚合物材料在能源存储、柔性电子和生物电子等领域的应用前景广阔，但传统制造技术如喷墨打印、丝网印刷和光刻工艺存在分辨率低、二维结构限制及高成本等问题，阻碍了其快速创新与广泛应用。本文提出了一种基于聚(3,4-乙撑二氧噻吩):聚苯乙烯磺酸盐（PEDOT:PSS）的高性能3D打印导电聚合物墨水，通过冷冻干燥和溶剂重分散技术优化了其流变性能，实现了高分辨率、高纵横比及可重复性的微结构打印。该墨水在干态下具有高导电性（155 S cm⁻¹），且可通过湿环境吸水转化为柔软的PEDOT:PSS水凝胶，具备良好的生物相容性。通过多材料3D打印技术，成功制备了高密度柔性电子电路和可植入式神经探针，后者可在活体动物中实现单单元神经信号记录。实验结果表明，该导电聚合物在干态下具有1.5 GPa的杨氏模量，在湿态下则降至1.1 MPa，兼具机械强度与柔韧性，适用于生物电子设备和植入式医疗应用。

本文创新性地将高浓度PEDOT:PSS纳米纤维通过冷冻干燥和溶剂重分散转化为3D打印墨水，解决了传统导电聚合物在3D打印中的流动性问题。该墨水在5-7 wt%的PEDOT:PSS纳米纤维浓度范围内表现出最佳流变性能，可实现微米级高分辨率及复杂结构的打印。通过干热处理后，导电聚合物可转化为具有155 S cm⁻¹导电性的稳定结构，并进一步吸水形成柔软且导电性高的水凝胶。多材料3D打印技术的应用使得神经探针等生物电子器件能够快速、高效地制造，其在活体动物中的应用验证了该材料的生物相容性和长期稳定性。

实验结果表明，所开发的3D打印导电聚合物墨水具有优异的打印性能和机械特性，可广泛应用于柔性电子、生物传感器及医疗植入设备。该技术不仅克服了传统制造方法的局限性，还为导电聚合物在复杂结构和高精度应用中的发展提供了新的可能性。
items.research_logic: 作者通过分析现有3D打印技术的局限性，提出开发高性能3D打印导电聚合物墨水的假说。通过实验验证该墨水的流变学性质和打印性能，并排除了其他可能的替代解释，如传统方法的限制。综述部分则通过比较不同材料的打印能力和应用效果，组织证据以支持导电聚合物在3D打印中的优势。每一步实验设计均基于对现有技术瓶颈的深入理解，确保结果的可重复性和实用性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，3D打印技术通过优化导电聚合物墨水的流变性能，实现了高分辨率、高纵横比及复杂结构的快速制造。该方法利用cryogenic冷冻和溶剂重分散技术，使PEDOT:PSS在中间浓度范围内（5-7 wt%）获得最佳3D打印特性，从而突破传统制备工艺的局限性。此设计原则可迁移至其他需要高精度微结构制造的领域，如生物电子设备或柔性电子器件，但需注意材料选择与浓度控制的适用边界。
items.selection_reason: 本文提出了一种高性能的3D打印导电聚合物墨水，基于聚(3,4-乙撑二氧噻吩):聚苯乙烯磺酸盐（PEDOT:PSS），实现了导电聚合物的高精度、高aspect ratio微结构制造。该墨水通过冷冻干燥和溶剂重分散制备，具有优异的3D打印性能，可实现高分辨率（>30 µm）和高aspect ratio（>20层）。其打印后可通过干燥退火转化为高导电性且柔性的PEDOT:PSS微结构，并进一步转化为软而导电的水凝胶。该方法克服了传统制造技术在分辨率、aspect ratio及复杂工艺方面的局限，通过多材料3D打印实现了导电聚合物器件的快速制备，如柔性电子电路和可植入神经探针。其优势在于无需复杂步骤即可实现高精度结构制造，且具有良好的生物相容性与长期稳定性。
items.application_prospects: 本文提出了一种高性能的3D打印导电聚合物墨水，用于制备高分辨率、高 aspect ratio 的微结构。该墨水基于 PEDOT:PSS 制成，具有优异的3D打印性能和可重复性，可与绝缘弹性体等其他3D打印材料集成。通过干燥退火，可将3D打印的导电聚合物转化为高导电性和柔性的PEDOT:PSS微结构，并进一步转化为软而导电的水凝胶。该技术在生物电子设备中具有应用前景，如软神经探针可用于体内单单元记录。
items.future_directions: 本文提出未来可检验的问题：如何利用3D打印技术进一步优化导电聚合物的微结构设计以提升其在生物电子设备中的长期稳定性？此外，探索不同溶剂混合比例对导电聚合物墨水流变性能的影响，可能为多材料3D打印提供更优参数。

fields.en:
The application prospects of 3D printed conductive polymer materials in fields such as energy storage, flexible electronics, and bioelectronics are broad, but traditional manufacturing techniques such as inkjet printing, screen printing, and photolithography have issues such as low resolution, two-dimensional structure limitations, and high costs, which hinder their rapid innovation and widespread application. This paper proposes a high-performance 3D printed conductive polymer ink based on poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrenesulfonate) (PEDOT:PSS), which optimizes its rheological properties through freeze-drying and solvent redistribution technology, achieving high resolution, high aspect ratio, and repeatability in microstructure printing. The ink has high conductivity (155 S cm⁻¹) in dry state, and can be converted into a soft PEDOT:PSS hydrogel by absorbing water in wet environments, exhibiting good biocompatibility. Through multi-material 3D printing technology, high-density flexible electronic circuits and implantable neural probes are successfully fabricated. The latter can achieve single-unit neural signal recording in live animals. Experimental results show that the conductive polymer has a Young's modulus of 1.5 GPa in dry state and drops to 1.1 MPa in wet state, combining mechanical strength and flexibility, making it suitable for bioelectronic devices and implantable medical applications.

This paper innovatively converts high-concentration PEDOT:PSS nanofibers into 3D printing ink through freeze-drying and solvent re-dispersion, solving the flowability issues of conventional conductive polymers in 3D printing. The ink exhibits optimal rheological performance within a concentration range of 5-7 wt% of PEDOT:PSS nanofibers, enabling micro-scale high-resolution and complex structure printing. After dry heat treatment, the conductive polymer can be transformed into a stable structure with a conductivity of 155 S cm⁻¹, and further absorbs water to form a soft, highly conductive hydrogel. The application of multi-material 3D printing technology enables the rapid and efficient manufacturing of bioelectronic devices such as neural probes, and its application in live animals validates the biocompatibility and long-term stability of the material.

The experimental results show that the developed 3D printed conductive polymer ink has excellent printing performance and mechanical properties, which can be widely applied in flexible electronics, biosensors, and medical implants. This technology not only overcomes the limitations of traditional manufacturing methods, but also provides new possibilities for the development of conductive polymers in complex structures and high-precision applications.

3D打印导电聚合物材料在能源存储、柔性电子和生物电子等领域的应用前景广阔，但传统制造技术如喷墨打印、丝网印刷和光刻工艺存在分辨率低、二维结构限制及高成本等问题，阻碍了其快速创新与广泛应用。本文提出了一种基于聚(3,4-乙撑二氧噻吩):聚苯乙烯磺酸盐（PEDOT:PSS）的高性能3D打印导电聚合物墨水，通过冷冻干燥和溶剂重分散技术优化了其流变性能，实现了高分辨率、高纵横比及可重复性的微结构打印。该墨水在干态下具有高导电性（155 S cm⁻¹），且可通过湿环境吸水转化为柔软的PEDOT:PSS水凝胶，具备良好的生物相容性。通过多材料3D打印技术，成功制备了高密度柔性电子电路和可植入式神经探针，后者可在活体动物中实现单单元神经信号记录。实验结果表明，该导电聚合物在干态下具有1.5 GPa的杨氏模量，在湿态下则降至1.1 MPa，兼具机械强度与柔韧性，适用于生物电子设备和植入式医疗应用。

实验结果表明，所开发的3D打印导电聚合物墨水具有优异的打印性能和机械特性，可广泛应用于柔性电子、生物传感器及医疗植入设备。该技术不仅克服了传统制造方法的局限性，还为导电聚合物在复杂结构和高精度应用中的发展提供了新的可能性。

paragraphs.en: The application prospects of 3D printed conductive polymer materials in fields such as energy storage, flexible electronics, and bioelectronics are broad, but traditional manufacturing techniques such as inkjet printing, screen printing, and photolithography have issues such as low resolution, two-dimensional structure limitations, and high costs, which hinder their rapid innovation and widespread application. This paper proposes a high-performance 3D printed conductive polymer ink based on poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrenesulfonate) (PEDOT:PSS), which optimizes its rheological properties through freeze-drying and solvent redistribution technology, achieving high resolution, high aspect ratio, and repeatability in microstructure printing. The ink has high conductivity (155 S cm⁻¹) in dry state, and can be converted into a soft PEDOT:PSS hydrogel by absorbing water in wet environments, exhibiting good biocompatibility. Through multi-material 3D printing technology, high-density flexible electronic circuits and implantable neural probes are successfully fabricated. The latter can achieve single-unit neural signal recording in live animals. Experimental results show that the conductive polymer has a Young's modulus of 1.5 GPa in dry state and drops to 1.1 MPa in wet state, combining mechanical strength and flexibility, making it suitable for bioelectronic devices and implantable medical applications.

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis for developing high-performance 3D printing conductive polymer inks by analyzing the limitations of existing 3D printing technologies. The experimental validation of the ink's rheological properties and printing performance is conducted, excluding other possible alternative explanations such as the limitations of traditional methods. The review section organizes evidence by comparing the printing capabilities and application effects of different materials to support the advantages of conductive polymers in 3D printing. Each step of the experimental design is based on a deep understanding of existing technical bottlenecks, ensuring the repeatability and practicality of the results.
fields.zh: 作者通过分析现有3D打印技术的局限性，提出开发高性能3D打印导电聚合物墨水的假说。通过实验验证该墨水的流变学性质和打印性能，并排除了其他可能的替代解释，如传统方法的限制。综述部分则通过比较不同材料的打印能力和应用效果，组织证据以支持导电聚合物在3D打印中的优势。每一步实验设计均基于对现有技术瓶颈的深入理解，确保结果的可重复性和实用性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that 3D printing technology achieves high-resolution, high aspect ratio, and complex structure rapid manufacturing by optimizing the rheological properties of conductive polymer inks. This method utilizes cryogenic freezing and solvent redistribution techniques to achieve optimal 3D printing characteristics for PEDOT:PSS within the intermediate concentration range (5-7 wt%), thereby breaking through the limitations of traditional preparation processes. This design principle can be transferred to other fields requiring high-precision microstructure manufacturing, such as bioelectronic devices or flexible electronic devices, but attention should be paid to the applicability boundaries of material selection and concentration control.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，3D打印技术通过优化导电聚合物墨水的流变性能，实现了高分辨率、高纵横比及复杂结构的快速制造。该方法利用cryogenic冷冻和溶剂重分散技术，使PEDOT:PSS在中间浓度范围内（5-7 wt%）获得最佳3D打印特性，从而突破传统制备工艺的局限性。此设计原则可迁移至其他需要高精度微结构制造的领域，如生物电子设备或柔性电子器件，但需注意材料选择与浓度控制的适用边界。

fields.en: This paper proposes a high-performance 3D printing conductive polymer ink based on poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrene sulfonate) (PEDOT:PSS), achieving high precision and high aspect ratio microstructure fabrication of conductive polymers. The ink is prepared through freeze-drying and solvent redistribution, exhibiting excellent 3D printing performance that enables high resolution (>30 µm) and high aspect ratio (>20 layers). After printing, the structure can be converted into a highly conductive and flexible PEDOT:PSS microstructure through drying and annealing, and further transformed into a soft and conductive hydrogel. Its advantages lie in achieving high-precision structure fabrication without complex steps, and it exhibits good biocompatibility and long-term stability.

fields.en: This paper proposes a high-performance 3D printed conductive polymer ink for the preparation of high-resolution, high aspect ratio microstructures. The ink is based on PEDOT:PSS and exhibits excellent 3D printing performance and reproducibility, allowing integration with other 3D printed materials such as insulating elastomers. By drying and annealing, 3D printed conductive polymers can be converted into high conductivity and flexible PEDOT:PSS microstructures, and further transformed into soft and conductive hydrogels. paragraphs.en: This paper proposes a high-performance 3D printed conductive polymer ink for the preparation of high-resolution, high aspect ratio microstructures. The ink is based on PEDOT:PSS and exhibits excellent 3D printing performance and reproducibility, allowing integration with other 3D printed materials such as insulating elastomers. By drying and annealing, 3D printed conductive polymers can be converted into high conductivity and flexible PEDOT:PSS microstructures, and further transformed into soft and conductive hydrogels. This technology has potential applications in bioelectronic devices, such as soft neural probes for in vivo single-unit recording.

decisions.focus: The study investigates the role of MOF-5 in enhancing Li+ ion transport in polymer electrolytes through molecular dynamics and metadynamics simulations.

The study presents a comprehensive analysis of how MOF-5 influences ion transport in polymer electrolytes through classical and well-tempered metadynamics simulations. The findings reveal that MOF-5 significantly enhances Li+ ion mobility by creating favorable local environments, reducing ion-trapping effects, and lowering free-energy barriers for ion movement. These results provide critical insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying improved ion transport in hybrid MOF-polymer electrolytes, offering valuable guidance for designing advanced solid-state batteries.

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract The structural and dynamical properties of simulation systems consisting of metal organic frameworks (MOFs), particularly MOF-5, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide (LiTFSI) salt, and two well-known polymers, poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF) and poly(ethylene oxide) (PEO), in different compositions were investigated using classical molecular dynamics (cMD) and well-tempered metadynamics (WT-MD) simulations. The cMD simulations revealed that the PEO-based hybrid electrolyte system containing LiTFSI salt and MOF-5 (System D) exhibits the highest diffusion coefficient for Li + ions and comparatively weaker interactions between Li + ions and the surrounding TFSI − anions than the other investigated systems. The enhanced ionic mobility is attributed to the favorable local environment generated by the incorporation of MOF-5, which facilitates efficient Li + ion transport while reducing ion-trapping effects, as evidenced by structural properties in terms of radial distribution functions, structure factors, spatial distribution functions, three-dimensional density distributions, ion pairing, and contact number analysis obtained from cMD. In addition, consistent with the structural properties, the dynamical and thermodynamic properties, evaluated through mean squared displacement and potential of mean force analysis, also indicate a high diffusion coefficient for Li + ions and favorable free-energy of Li + –PEO interactions in System D. Furthermore, WT-MD simulations demonstrated that System D possesses a relatively lower free-energy barrier for Li + ion mobility, indicating energetically favorable ion transport pathways. The combined findings from cMD and WT-MD simulations highlight the critical role of MOF-5 in regulating the dynamics and transport behavior of Li + ions. Therefore, this study provides valuable design guidelines for engineering hybrid MOF–polymer electrolytes with optimized ion transport properties for solid-state battery applications.

items.action:
研究论文探讨了金属有机框架-5（MOF-5）对聚乙烯氧化物（PEO）和聚偏二氟乙烯（PVDF）电解质中锂离子传输的增强作用，通过经典分子动力学（cMD）和温控元动力学（WT-MD）模拟分析其结构与动态特性。研究发现，在包含LiTFSI盐和MOF-5的PEO基混合电解质系统（System D）中，锂离子的扩散系数最高，且锂离子与周围TFSI⁻阴离子之间的相互作用较弱。这一现象归因于MOF-5的引入所形成的有利局部环境，有效促进了锂离子传输并减少了离子陷阱效应。通过cMD模拟获得的径向分布函数、结构因子、空间分布函数、三维密度分布、离子配对和接触数分析等结构性质，以及通过均方位移和平均势能分析得到的动力学与热力学性质，均表明System D中锂离子具有较高的扩散系数和有利的自由能。此外，WT-MD模拟进一步显示System D中锂离子迁移的自由能屏障较低，表明其能量上更有利于离子传输路径。综合cMD和WT-MD模拟结果，MOF-5在调节锂离子动态行为和传输特性方面发挥了关键作用。因此，该研究为设计具有优化离子传输性能的混合MOF-聚合物电解质提供了有价值的指导，以满足固态电池的应用需求。

论文中通过对比PEO和PVDF两种聚合物矩阵，探讨了MOF-5在不同聚合物基质中的离子传输能力。研究采用经典分子动力学模拟分析了MOF-5与PVDF、PEO聚合物及LiTFSI盐的结构与动态特性，并利用WT-MD模拟确定了锂离子迁移相关的自由能分布，提供了分子层面的能量因素描述。通过结合结构性质、动力学和热力学性质的综合分析，研究明确了MOF-5在不同聚合物系统中对锂离子传输的影响机制。

综述文献指出，MOF-5在增强固态电解质中锂离子传输方面具有潜在优势，但其分子作用机制尚不完全明确。本文通过cMD和WT-MD模拟揭示了MOF-5如何通过优化局部环境促进锂离子传输，并提供了分子层面的结构与动力学分析结果。研究结果表明，MOF-5的引入能够有效改善聚合物电解质中锂离子的扩散行为，为设计高性能固态电池电解质提供了理论依据和实践指导。
items.research_logic: 作者通过cMD和WT-MD模拟系统性研究了MOF-5对PEO和PVDF基电解质中Li+传输的影响。首先，通过cMD模拟发现MOF-5掺杂的系统（System D）具有最高的Li+扩散系数和较弱的Li+与TFSI−相互作用，表明MOF-5优化了局部环境以促进Li+传输并减少离子陷阱效应。随后，WT-MD模拟进一步验证了System D中Li+迁移的自由能屏障较低，说明能量有利的传输路径。这些结果通过结构和动力学性质分析（如径向分布函数、空间分布函数等）得到支持。综述分析则通过比较不同聚合物矩阵对MOF-5离子传输能力的影响，揭示了MOF-5在调节电解质动态和传输行为中的关键作用。每一步验证均基于模拟数据，确保结论的可靠性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，本研究通过结合经典分子动力学（cMD）和温控元动力学（WT-MD）模拟，揭示了MOF-5在聚合物电解质中调控Li+离子传输的机制。MOF-5通过优化局部溶剂化环境，降低离子迁移能垒，从而提升Li+扩散系数和与PEO的相互作用自由能。这一设计原则可应用于其他离子传输受限的固态电池材料开发，但需注意聚合物基质性质对MOF-5效果的影响。
items.selection_reason: 本研究通过经典分子动力学（cMD）和温控元动力学（WT-MD）模拟，系统分析了MOF-5对聚乙烯氧化物（PEO）和聚偏氟乙烯（PVDF）基聚合物电解质中Li+离子传输的影响。研究发现，在PEO基电解质系统中，MOF-5的引入显著提高了Li+的扩散系数，并降低了离子陷阱效应，这主要归因于MOF-5生成的有利局部环境。通过结构和动力学分析，如径向分布函数、空间分布函数等，证实了MOF-5对PEO中Li+与PEO相互作用的自由能有积极影响。此外，WT-MD模拟进一步表明，MOF-5降低了Li+离子迁移的自由能壁垒，为离子传输提供了能量有利的路径。这些发现揭示了MOF-5在调控聚合物电解质动态和传输行为中的关键作用，为设计具有优化离子传输性能的混合MOF-聚合物电解质提供了理论依据。研究结果符合实验数据，并通过结构和动力学分析验证了MOF-5对Li+传输的促进作用。
items.application_prospects: 本文通过cMD和WT-MD模拟研究了MOF-5在PEO和PVDF电解质中的作用，发现MOF-5显著提高了Li+离子的扩散系数和传输效率。实验表明，MOF-5优化了局部环境，减少了离子陷阱效应，从而改善了离子传输行为。该研究为设计高性能固态聚合物电解质提供了理论依据，适用于下一代锂离子电池应用。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可进一步探讨MOF-5在不同聚合物基质中的作用机制，特别是其对离子迁移路径和自由能屏障的影响。通过结合cMD与WT-MD模拟结果，可以设计更精确的计算方法来预测MOF-5对Li+传输的优化效果，并验证其在固态电池中的实际应用潜力。此外，可进一步研究MOF-5与其他金属有机框架材料的协同效应，以提升离子传导性能和电解质稳定性。

fields.en:
The research paper explores the enhancing effect of metal-organic framework-5 (MOF-5) on lithium ion transport in polyethylene oxide (PEO) and polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) electrolytes. The study analyzes the structural and dynamic properties of MOF-5 through classical molecular dynamics (cMD) and temperature-controlled molecular dynamics (WT-MD) simulations. The research findings show that in a PEO-based mixed electrolyte system (System D) containing LiTFSI salt and MOF-5, the diffusion coefficient of lithium ions is highest, and the interaction between lithium ions and surrounding TFSI⁻ anions is relatively weak. This phenomenon is attributed to the favorable local environment formed by the introduction of MOF-5, which effectively promotes lithium ion transport and reduces the ion trapping effect. Structural properties obtained from cMD simulations include radial distribution functions, structure factors, spatial distribution functions, three-dimensional density distributions, ion pairing, and contact numbers. Dynamic and thermodynamic properties derived from mean square displacement and average potential energy analysis also indicate that lithium ions in System D have a high diffusion coefficient and favorable free energy. Furthermore, WT-MD simulations further show that the free energy barrier for lithium ion migration in System D is low, indicating that it is more energetically favorable for the ion transport pathway. Combining cMD and WT-MD simulation results, MOF-5 plays a key role in regulating the dynamic behavior and transport characteristics of lithium ions. Therefore, this study provides valuable guidance for designing mixed MOF-polymer electrolytes with optimized ion transport performance to meet the application requirements of solid-state batteries.

The paper compares PEO and PVDF as polymer matrices to explore the ion transport capability of MOF-5 in different polymer matrices. The study employs classical molecular dynamics simulations to analyze the structure and dynamic properties of MOF-5 with PVDF, PEO polymers, and LiTFSI salt, and uses WT-MD simulations to determine the free energy distribution related to lithium ion migration, providing a molecular-level description of energy factors. By integrating structural properties, kinetic, and thermodynamic properties, the study clarifies the mechanism by which MOF-5 affects lithium ion transport in different polymer systems.

Review literature indicates that MOF-5 has potential advantages in enhancing lithium ion transport in solid electrolytes, but its molecular interaction mechanism is still not fully elucidated. This paper reveals how MOF-5 promotes lithium ion transport by optimizing the local environment through cMD and WT-MD simulations, and provides structural and dynamic analysis results at the molecular level. The study shows that the introduction of MOF-5 can effectively improve the diffusion behavior of lithium ions in polymer electrolytes, providing theoretical basis and practical guidance for designing high-performance solid-state battery electrolytes.

研究论文探讨了金属有机框架-5（MOF-5）对聚乙烯氧化物（PEO）和聚偏二氟乙烯（PVDF）电解质中锂离子传输的增强作用，通过经典分子动力学（cMD）和温控元动力学（WT-MD）模拟分析其结构与动态特性。研究发现，在包含LiTFSI盐和MOF-5的PEO基混合电解质系统（System D）中，锂离子的扩散系数最高，且锂离子与周围TFSI⁻阴离子之间的相互作用较弱。这一现象归因于MOF-5的引入所形成的有利局部环境，有效促进了锂离子传输并减少了离子陷阱效应。通过cMD模拟获得的径向分布函数、结构因子、空间分布函数、三维密度分布、离子配对和接触数分析等结构性质，以及通过均方位移和平均势能分析得到的动力学与热力学性质，均表明System D中锂离子具有较高的扩散系数和有利的自由能。此外，WT-MD模拟进一步显示System D中锂离子迁移的自由能屏障较低，表明其能量上更有利于离子传输路径。综合cMD和WT-MD模拟结果，MOF-5在调节锂离子动态行为和传输特性方面发挥了关键作用。因此，该研究为设计具有优化离子传输性能的混合MOF-聚合物电解质提供了有价值的指导，以满足固态电池的应用需求。

论文中通过对比PEO和PVDF两种聚合物矩阵，探讨了MOF-5在不同聚合物基质中的离子传输能力。研究采用经典分子动力学模拟分析了MOF-5与PVDF、PEO聚合物及LiTFSI盐的结构与动态特性，并利用WT-MD模拟确定了锂离子迁移相关的自由能分布，提供了分子层面的能量因素描述。通过结合结构性质、动力学和热力学性质的综合分析，研究明确了MOF-5在不同聚合物系统中对锂离子传输的影响机制。

综述文献指出，MOF-5在增强固态电解质中锂离子传输方面具有潜在优势，但其分子作用机制尚不完全明确。本文通过cMD和WT-MD模拟揭示了MOF-5如何通过优化局部环境促进锂离子传输，并提供了分子层面的结构与动力学分析结果。研究结果表明，MOF-5的引入能够有效改善聚合物电解质中锂离子的扩散行为，为设计高性能固态电池电解质提供了理论依据和实践指导。

paragraphs.en: The research paper explores the enhancing effect of metal-organic framework-5 (MOF-5) on lithium ion transport in polyethylene oxide (PEO) and polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) electrolytes. The study analyzes the structural and dynamic properties of MOF-5 through classical molecular dynamics (cMD) and temperature-controlled molecular dynamics (WT-MD) simulations. The research findings show that in a PEO-based mixed electrolyte system (System D) containing LiTFSI salt and MOF-5, the diffusion coefficient of lithium ions is highest, and the interaction between lithium ions and surrounding TFSI⁻ anions is relatively weak. This phenomenon is attributed to the favorable local environment formed by the introduction of MOF-5, which effectively promotes lithium ion transport and reduces the ion trapping effect. Structural properties obtained from cMD simulations include radial distribution functions, structure factors, spatial distribution functions, three-dimensional density distributions, ion pairing, and contact numbers. Dynamic and thermodynamic properties derived from mean square displacement and average potential energy analysis also indicate that lithium ions in System D have a high diffusion coefficient and favorable free energy. Furthermore, WT-MD simulations further show that the free energy barrier for lithium ion migration in System D is low, indicating that it is more energetically favorable for the ion transport pathway. Combining cMD and WT-MD simulation results, MOF-5 plays a key role in regulating the dynamic behavior and transport characteristics of lithium ions. Therefore, this study provides valuable guidance for designing mixed MOF-polymer electrolytes with optimized ion transport performance to meet the application requirements of solid-state batteries.

paragraphs.en: The paper compares PEO and PVDF as polymer matrices to explore the ion transport capability of MOF-5 in different polymer matrices. The study employs classical molecular dynamics simulations to analyze the structure and dynamic properties of MOF-5 with PVDF, PEO polymers, and LiTFSI salt, and uses WT-MD simulations to determine the free energy distribution related to lithium ion migration, providing a molecular-level description of energy factors. By integrating structural properties, kinetic, and thermodynamic properties, the study clarifies the mechanism by which MOF-5 affects lithium ion transport in different polymer systems.

paragraphs.en: Review literature indicates that MOF-5 has potential advantages in enhancing lithium ion transport in solid electrolytes, but its molecular interaction mechanism is still not fully elucidated. This paper reveals how MOF-5 promotes lithium ion transport by optimizing the local environment through cMD and WT-MD simulations, and provides structural and dynamic analysis results at the molecular level. The study shows that the introduction of MOF-5 can effectively improve the diffusion behavior of lithium ions in polymer electrolytes, providing theoretical basis and practical guidance for designing high-performance solid-state battery electrolytes.

fields.en: The author systematically studied the effect of MOF-5 on Li+ transport in PEO and PVDF-based electrolytes through cMD and WT-MD simulations. First, the cMD simulation revealed that System D with MOF-5 doping has the highest Li+ diffusion coefficient and weaker Li+ interaction with TFSI−, indicating that MOF-5 optimizes the local environment to promote Li+ transport and reduce ion trapping effects. Subsequently, the WT-MD simulation further confirmed that the energy barrier for Li+ migration in System D is lower, suggesting favorable energy pathways for transmission. These results were supported by structural and dynamic property analyses (such as radial distribution functions, spatial distribution functions, etc.). The review analysis revealed the key role of MOF-5 in regulating the dynamics and transport behavior of electrolytes by comparing the effects of different polymer matrices on MOF-5 ion transport capability. Each step was validated based on simulation data to ensure the reliability of the conclusions.
fields.zh: 作者通过cMD和WT-MD模拟系统性研究了MOF-5对PEO和PVDF基电解质中Li+传输的影响。首先，通过cMD模拟发现MOF-5掺杂的系统（System D）具有最高的Li+扩散系数和较弱的Li+与TFSI−相互作用，表明MOF-5优化了局部环境以促进Li+传输并减少离子陷阱效应。随后，WT-MD模拟进一步验证了System D中Li+迁移的自由能屏障较低，说明能量有利的传输路径。这些结果通过结构和动力学性质分析（如径向分布函数、空间分布函数等）得到支持。综述分析则通过比较不同聚合物矩阵对MOF-5离子传输能力的影响，揭示了MOF-5在调节电解质动态和传输行为中的关键作用。每一步验证均基于模拟数据，确保结论的可靠性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study reveals the mechanism by which MOF-5 regulates Li+ ion transport in polymer electrolytes through the combination of classical molecular dynamics (cMD) and temperature-controlled ensemble dynamics (WT-MD) simulations. MOF-5 optimizes the local solvation environment to reduce the ion migration energy barrier, thereby enhancing the diffusion coefficient of Li+ and the interaction free energy with PEO. This design principle can be applied to the development of other solid-state battery materials with restricted ion transport, but attention should be paid to the effect of polymer matrix properties on the effectiveness of MOF-5.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，本研究通过结合经典分子动力学（cMD）和温控元动力学（WT-MD）模拟，揭示了MOF-5在聚合物电解质中调控Li+离子传输的机制。MOF-5通过优化局部溶剂化环境，降低离子迁移能垒，从而提升Li+扩散系数和与PEO的相互作用自由能。这一设计原则可应用于其他离子传输受限的固态电池材料开发，但需注意聚合物基质性质对MOF-5效果的影响。

fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study systematically analyzed the effect of MOF-5 on the transport of Li+ ions in polymer electrolytes based on polyethylene oxide (PEO) and polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) through classical molecular dynamics (cMD) and temperature-controlled Monte Carlo dynamics (WT-MD) simulations. The results showed that the introduction of MOF-5 significantly increased the diffusion coefficient of Li+ ions and reduced the ion trap effect in PEO-based electrolyte systems, which is mainly attributed to the favorable local environment generated by MOF-5. Through structural and dynamic analyses, such as radial distribution functions and spatial distribution functions, it was confirmed that MOF-5 has a positive impact on the free energy of interaction between Li+ and PEO. Furthermore, WT-MD simulations further demonstrated that MOF-5 lowers the free energy barrier for Li+ ion migration, providing an energetically favorable pathway for ion transport. These findings highlight the key role of MOF-5 in regulating the dynamic and transport behavior of polymer electrolytes, providing a theoretical basis for designing hybrid MOF-polymer electrolytes with optimized ion transport performance. The results are consistent with experimental data and have been verified through structural and dynamic analyses to confirm the promoting effect of MOF-5 on Li+ transport.

fields.en: Future research could further explore the mechanism of MOF-5 in different polymer matrices, particularly its effects on ion migration pathways and free energy barriers. By combining cMD with WT-MD simulation results, more accurate computational methods can be designed to predict the optimized performance of MOF-5 for Li+ transport and verify its potential application in solid-state batteries. Additionally, further research could investigate the synergistic effects of MOF-5 with other metal-organic framework materials to enhance ion conductivity and electrolyte stability.

decisions.focus: Simplification of dosimetry workflows in radiopharmaceutical therapy

This review presents a critical analysis of current challenges in dosimetry for radiopharmaceutical therapy (RPT) and introduces simplification techniques to make dosimetry more practical. The article highlights the limitations of traditional dosimetry workflows, such as the need for multiple time-point imaging and complex computational modeling, which hinder their use in clinical settings. It proposes a theoretical framework that classifies simplification methods into three categories: data acquisition reduction, computational automation via AI, and advanced modeling strategies. The review emphasizes the importance of developing efficient and validated approaches to enable widespread adoption of personalized dosimetry in RPT.
